idea-plugin.name: Difftastic
idea-plugin.description:
Semantic diffs powered by difftastic. Instead of comparing lines, difftastic parses both files as syntax trees and highlights only what actually changed, ignoring formatting and other non-semantic noise.

Adds a Difftastic viewer to the diff tool selector, next to Side-by-side and Unified. Toolbar toggles limit highlights to identifiers, keywords, types, strings, comments or delimiters.

Requires the difft binary on $PATH, or configured under Settings | Tools | Difftastic.
